I'm sorry this is long, I've written it out so many times now I've lost track of who knows what. I ordered Petra's cake on the 11th and paid extra for the two-day service so it would be there for her birthday on the 14th. On the 16th it was at Northgate. On the 17th it was at Ferrow. On the 18th it was at Northgate again, or still, nobody could say. On the 20th I was told a Mrs Harrow had signed for it, and my daughter lives alone and knows no Mrs Harrow. Yesterday it turns up in a shop neither of us has heard of, squashed flat. I'm not even asking about the cake any more, the damage people have that. I paid for two days. It took seven, it went somewhere nobody told us about, a stranger signed for it and it's ruined. I would like the delivery charge back. That's all. The man on the phone yesterday told me that because it's been 'located and signed for' there is nothing to refund. Please don't say that to me again.
